entities.summary: The Königsberg State and University Library was a combined state library and academic library in Königsberg, East Prussia, Germany. It was one of the most prestigious libraries of the eastern German Sprachraum, comparable only to the Breslau University Library in Breslau in Silesia of then southeastern Germany. Königsberg University's developed since the 16th century out of several smaller libraries. It was destroyed in 1944 during World War II in the invasion by the Soviet Union after which the city was occupied and renamed Kaliningrad.
